_readme: Fill these in with confirmed details from the store. Leave a value as "" (or as its {{PLACEHOLDER}}) until it's confirmed: in review mode it shows as a {{PLACEHOLDER}} chip, in presentation mode it's hidden. Hours are 24h "HH:MM" in the store's timezone; set a day to null if the store is closed that day. announcements: the lines in the thin bar under the nav, e.g. "Holiday candy baskets are in" or "Fresh smoked fish this week"; the bar disappears if none are filled in. holidayHours: rows under Holiday hours in Visit us, e.g. { "date": "Dec 24", "hours": "9:00 AM – 3:00 PM" }; delete rows you don't need.
